response.overview: Yuyeon is a mime artist who communicates without words, expressing everything through his body.  After an accident leaves Sohyun with a hearing impairment, the two—unfamiliar with sign language—develop a habit of communicating through text messages on their smartphones.  Over time, however, their growing reliance on screens begins to create an emotional distance. Even when they’re in the same room, they feel worlds apart.  In an attempt to bridge the gap, Yuyeon invites Sohyun to a performance unlike any other—one he has prepared just for her.  But how can a mime artist share his true feelings with someone who cannot hear?  How will he reach her heart when even their words have grown silent?
response.title: BEYOND THE SCREEN
